narrator.instruct: Gripping, energetic storyteller telling a true Wild West mystery, brisk and playful, never calm.

bart.instruct: An extremely polite, soft-spoken gentleman robber, calm and courteous, almost apologetic.

hume.instruct: A frustrated, tired detective, gruff and exasperated.

laundryman.instruct: A cheerful, chatty laundry clerk, proud of his customers, quick and friendly.

morse.instruct: A dry, confident detective, quietly amused, savouring the moment.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He robbed twenty-eight stagecoaches, and he was finally caught by his laundry.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meet Black Bart. A sack over his head, a shotgun he never fired.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He took the strongbox, left a poem, and vanished into the hills.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody ever saw his face. Detectives James Hume and Harry Morse had nothing.

lines.speaker: hume
lines.text: No name, no face, no trail.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Because by day, Black Bart was Charles Bolton, a gentleman in mining with fine white shirts.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then, in eighteen eighty-three, a young man by the road fires at the running bandit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bart is barely grazed. But in the bushes, he leaves something behind. A handkerchief.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In one corner, four tiny marks. F, X, O, seven.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You see, every city laundry stamped its own code on your linen, so your shirts came back to you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And each laundry kept a book. Code on one side, customer on the other.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the detectives carried one handkerchief from laundry to laundry.

lines.speaker: laundryman
lines.text: F, X, O, seven? That's Mister Bolton. Very clean man.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The detectives knock on the gentleman's door.

lines.speaker: morse
lines.text: Good morning, Mister Bolton. Or should we say, Bart?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Twenty-eight robberies without a single shot, undone by one dirty handkerchief.
